rows.scene: A single all-pervading presence and varied flames evoke the chapter’s first teaching.
rows.candidate_status: Three groups of distinct logs carry small, medium and large flames against the cosmic spiral; no people or text appear. Independent exact-checksum review passed; no artwork approval.

rows.scene: The guru instructs an attentive seated disciple beside the two crossed aranis.
rows.candidate_status: Exactly two generic seated figures: the older guru faces and instructs the attentive disciple beside the two crossed aranis; both logs remain distinct beneath a small fire and separate branch tangle. At native and enlarged views each figure has one head, two arms, two hands, two legs and two feet; visible hands show five digits and each of four bare feet shows five toes. Skin-only 11x11 medians: guru cheek (545,217) RGB (150,76,38) R-B 112; torso (410,320) (153,77,39) R-B 114; disciple cheek (1280,215) (152,80,43) R-B 109; torso (1295,315) (152,78,40) R-B 112. No readable text. Producer reviewed; fresh independent exact-checksum review passed; no artwork approval.

rows.scene: Bhattathiri turns from temporary remedies toward Bhagwan’s refuge.
rows.candidate_status: One older Bhattathiri kneels before one calm blue Bhagwan. The crown is low matte ochre with one feather; ornaments are modest and the raised hand is blue. Skin-only 11x11 medians at the same sample windows as prior versions have maximum R-B 120 (torso); the other listed samples are 103–119. The max is disclosed against the 115 guide; skin reads warm-brown. At enlarged view Bhattathiri has two connected arms and joined hands; Bhagwan has two attached arms and two open hands, with the raised hand showing thumb plus four fingers and the lap thumb naturally partly occluded. Visible feet show five toes each. No extra figure or text. Producer reviewed; independent review passed; no art approval.

producer_review.outcome: pass with disclosed Bhattathiri skin measurement deviation

rows.scene: Even the highest celestial realm is unsettled; the poet seeks refuge and release.
rows.candidate_status: Selected by Firstmate after direct review; remains unapproved. Native 1670x942. Brahma has exactly four heads and four attached arms with lotus, rosary, water pot and blank scripture; Bhattathiri has two arms and a small nape tuft; Bhagwan has two attached arms. Enlarged crops show both blue deity hands with a thumb and four fingers each (palm-side 11x11 B-R 180 and 186); both deity feet show five toes. Bhattathiri skin-only 11x11 R-B samples range 102–122, remaining warm-brown. DISCLOSED MINOR GENERATION DRIFT outside the hand edits: stars, cosmic-wave contours and planetary details differ from v029. Firstmate judged this minor and selected v034; no S004 regeneration. No extra figures or readable text; fresh independent exact-checksum review passed; no art approval.

producer_review.outcome: needs-fix producer report; selected by Firstmate ruling with disclosed minor background drift

rows.scene: One connected tree holds both dream and waking; the reclining figure now has two clearly separated arms, with the second hand visible on the thigh.
rows.candidate_status: One generic reclining figure rests on the connected dream/waking tree with its mango cluster and waking-side lotus. The forehead is plain and bare; no devotional ornaments are visible. A plain opaque warm-cream uttariya fully covers the chest and remains distinct from both arms. The figure has one head, two attached arms from distinct shoulder paths, two legs and two feet; the thigh-resting hand is visible and shows a thumb plus four fingers. The head-supporting hand shows four clear fingers; its thumb is partly occluded at the head contact, disclosed and accepted by Firstmate as previously accepted. Each visible foot shows five toes. Skin-only 11x11 median samples at upper-left crop origins: cheek (215,385) RGB (173,88,37), R-B 136; cheek (225,395) (176,92,40), R-B 136; cheek (235,410) (132,61,22), R-B 110; upper arm (480,430) (152,70,27), R-B 125; arm (520,435) (172,85,34), R-B 138. The recorded range is 110–138; values above the R-B 120 guide are disclosed. Firstmate directly reviewed and selected this version, noting that the exposed skin reads clearly warm brown. Fresh producer review is recorded; independent exact-checksum review passed; art remains unapproved.

producer_review.outcome: pass with accepted thumb occlusion and skin guide deviation disclosed

rows.scene: Bhattathiri offers his mind in devotion and receives the guru’s word.
rows.candidate_status: The garden scene retains one older devotee and one serene two-armed deity. Both deity hands are continuous blue from arms through palms and digits (sampled palm B-R 47–72). Each open hand shows a thumb plus four fingers; no extra arm or digit is visible. Bhattathiri's joined hands and five-toed exposed foot remain; both deity feet show five toes. No readable writing or added figure. Producer pass; independent review passed; no art approval.

rows.scene: An unmarked scripture and a healthy unmilked cow recall labor without devotion.
rows.candidate_status: The open two-leaf palm manuscript has smooth, flat, uniformly pale-tan faces with no repeated pattern, writing, glyphs, ruled lines or marks. The enlarged lower-body view shows four attached cow legs and four distinct hooves; the empty bowl and flower remain. Producer-reviewed pass; fresh independent exact-checksum review passed; no artwork approval.

rows.scene: Bhattathiri worships Bhagwan and follows the footprints of the beloved devotees.
rows.candidate_status: The scene retains one Bhattathiri and one Bhagwan with the veena, offerings and three separate footprint pairs. Both deity palms are continuous blue (sampled B-R 82–89); each deity hand and both Bhattathiri hands show a thumb plus four fingers. Bhattathiri's exposed foot and both deity feet show five toes. Faces and limb attachments remain clear; no added person or readable text. Producer pass; independent review passed; no art approval.

rows.scene: Bhattathiri serves at the temple while worshipping the four-armed Bhagwan.
rows.candidate_status: Selected S009 shrine-scale repair; independently reviewed and remains unapproved. Native 1670x942. The right medallion is approximately 268x391 px (about 16% of canvas width and 42% of height), within the requested 18% maximum width and 40–45% height. Bhagwan has one head and four attached blue arms, with one chakra, conch, lotus and mace each; all four hands read blue continuously with the arms. Attribute grips partly occlude finger separations; no extra or malformed digit is visible, with small digit details not fully resolvable at reduced icon size; the independent report records the limit and passes the image. Bhattathiri retains the sweeping pose, face, warm-brown skin, cream dhoti, broom and flower scatter; he has two arms, a hanging hand showing thumb plus four fingers, a closed broom grip, and both feet show five toes. Same-window skin-only 11x11 medians range R-B 110–129; the maximum 129 is disclosed above the below-120 guide and skin reads warm-brown. In focused crops, the deity feet are visible and no missing-toe defect is seen, but I cannot confidently count all five toe tips on each reduced foot; producer verdict was uncertain on this detail; independent review could not count the small deity toe tips at full size, but observed no missing-toe defect and passed the image. Fresh independent exact-checksum review passed; art remains unapproved.

producer_review.outcome: uncertain; target scale met, exact toe-tip count unresolved at reduced icon size

rows.scene: The gopikas’ loving circle around Krishna expresses the devotion he honors.

Krishna forehead is bare apart from one low band and feather; all ten visible hands show thumb plus four fingers, and each of eight visible gopika feet plus Krishna’s visible foot show five toes. Independent exact-checksum review passed; no artwork approval.
